verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Orama CLI. The pack covers official SDKs (JS/TS, Python, Rust), a hosted MCP server and a JavaScript runtime, but none of these is a command-line tool, so they earn no credit for this story. A search library and cloud platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
